mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.15% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% over 3 months signals labor market tightening that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and retail sales (RSAFS > 440000) indicate robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 440000.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) indicates stable supply chains that prevent inflationary pressures and support positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1200) signals strong residential construction activity that correlates with rising consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1200.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL 3m change > 2.0%) signals potential monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL 3m change exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS > 142000) and stable interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) indicates labor market strength without monetary policy disruption, supporting positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 142000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 16000) indicates robust economic expansion that drives corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 16000.
